notes: Printed: 'Whenever one or more creatures you control attack, they gain indestructible until end of turn.' The Guardian and a Bear attack; with the trigger on the stack the Bear is returned to its owner's hand and put back onto the battlefield. It is a new object (CR 400.7), not one of the creatures that attacked, so it does not gain indestructible: 10 damage kills it, while the Guardian survives it. Seat 1 takes the Guardian's 5. Red without the resolution-time CR 400.7 check (the grant would follow the Bear's handle) and on the base (30fabc4a), where the sentence did not compile.
